question: 如果问题无法重现，流程会如何进行？
options: A. 检查日志 (Check Logs)
B. 请求更多信息 (Request More Info)
C. 运行单元测试 (Run Unit Tests)
D. 分析日志 (Analyze Logs)

question: 在运行集成测试 (Run Integration Tests) 之后，下一步是以下哪一项？
options: A. 修复组件 (Fix Component)
B. 检查配置 (Check Configuration)
C. 检查系统状态 (Check System State)
D. 运行单元测试 (Run Unit Tests)

question: 从“分析日志 (Analyze Logs)”到“提交 PR (Submit PR)”，必须经过以下哪个节点？
options: A. 检查系统状态 (Check System State)
B. 运行集成测试 (Run Integration Tests)
C. 修复组件 (Fix Component)
D. 检查配置 (Check Configuration)

question: 以下哪个环节不是在调试级别较低时，尝试重现问题之前必须经过的步骤？
options: A. 检查日志 (Check Logs)
B. 设置 DEBUG_LEVEL=3 (Set DEBUG_LEVEL=3)
C. 分析日志 (Analyze Logs)
D. 判断是否可以重现 (Can Reproduce?)

question: 如果问题可以重现，且确定不是组件问题，那么从“检查日志 (Check Logs)”到“测试修复 (Test Fix)”必须经过的步骤是：
options: A. Debug Level -> Analyze Logs -> Run Unit Tests -> Fix Component
B. Debug Level -> Analyze Logs -> Run Integration Tests -> Check System State -> Check Configuration -> Fix Component
C. Debug Level -> Analyze Logs -> Check System State -> Check Configuration -> Fix Component
D. Debug Level -> Analyze Logs -> Run Integration Tests -> Fix Component

question: 从流程起点“问题报告 (Issue Reported)”到流程终点“提交 PR (Submit PR)”，以下哪条路径包含的节点数量最多？
options: A. Issue Reported -> Can Reproduce? -> Check Logs -> Debug Level -> Analyze Logs -> Component Issue? -> Run Unit Tests -> Fix Component -> Test Fix -> Submit PR

B. Issue Reported -> Can Reproduce? -> Check Logs -> Debug Level -> Set DEBUG_LEVEL=3 -> Can Reproduce? -> Check Logs -> Debug Level -> Analyze Logs -> Component Issue? -> Run Integration Tests -> Check System State -> Check Configuration -> Fix Component -> Test Fix -> Submit PR

C. Issue Reported -> Can Reproduce? -> Request More Info -> Issue Reported -> Can Reproduce? -> Check Logs -> Debug Level -> Analyze Logs -> Component Issue? -> Run Unit Tests -> Fix Component -> Test Fix -> Submit PR

D. Issue Reported -> Can Reproduce? -> Check Logs -> Debug Level -> Analyze Logs -> Component Issue? -> Run Integration Tests -> Check System State -> Check Configuration -> Fix Component -> Test Fix -> Submit PR
